mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications(recipient_id,ticket_id,event_id,type) SELECT #{recipientId},#{ticketId},#{eventId},#{type} FROM users WHERE id=#{recipientId} AND enabled=1
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET invalidated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND recipient_id=#{userId} AND invalidated_at IS NULL
